home.headline: Stay closer to the version of Jamaica you actually came for.
home.description: Blue Kottage helps guests discover beautiful stays, plan around local events, and find remote-work-friendly escapes without losing the feeling of a real trip.

highlights.title: Stay discovery that feels editorial
highlights.body: Lead with beaches, hills, food towns, and travel mood, not just generic listings.

highlights.title: Events that help shape the trip
highlights.body: See what is happening before you book so your stay lines up with music, culture, nightlife, or wellness.

highlights.title: Remote-work stays with useful detail
highlights.body: Nomad listings call out practical things like Wi-Fi speed, workspaces, and coworking access.

featuredStays.name: Blue Mountain Hideaway
featuredStays.summary: Cool air, coffee-country scenery, and room to unplug or work quietly.

featuredStays.name: Negril Weekend House
featuredStays.summary: Built for sunsets, beach days, and easy group weekends.

regions.title: Portland

regions.title: Montego Bay

regions.title: Blue Mountains

explore.headline: Start with the feeling of the trip, then find the stay.
explore.description: Explore coast, city, mountain, and remote-work-friendly stays across Jamaica before you narrow down dates and filters.

collections.title: Beach weekends
collections.body: For guests optimizing for sand, sunsets, and easy access to the water.

collections.title: City breaks
collections.body: For short stays around food, nightlife, meetings, or family visits.

collections.title: Quiet mountain stays
collections.body: For guests who want cooler weather, greenery, and a slower pace.

collections.title: Remote-work escapes
collections.body: For guests blending focused work time with a meaningful stay in Jamaica.

nomads.headline: Remote-work stays built for longer, calmer travel.
nomads.description: Nomad Verified listings spotlight practical work details like Wi-Fi speed, workspace setup, and coworking access, with the Nomad Pass added at checkout.

perks.title: Verified fast Wi-Fi
perks.body: See which stays can support calls, focused work, and longer sessions.

perks.title: Workspace details
perks.body: Look for private work areas, ergonomic seating, and quiet-room access.

perks.title: Coworking visibility
perks.body: Some stays include direct coworking access or partner guidance nearby.

properties.name: Port Antonio Work Retreat
